commands.command: set -euo pipefail; C=$HOME/agent-workspace/control; B=$HOME/agent-workspace/control.precompact; T=$HOME/agent-workspace/control-shallow-test; echo '=== DOCTOR BEFORE DELETE ==='; $HOME/local-agent/.venv/bin/python $HOME/local-agent/agentctl.py doctor; test "$(git -C $C rev-parse --is-shallow-repository)" = true; test "$(git -C $C config --get remote.origin.promisor)" = true; test "$(git -C $C sparse-checkout list)" = .agent; remote_tip=$(git -C $C ls-remote origin refs/heads/agent-control | awk '{print $1}'); test "$(git -C $C rev-parse HEAD)" = "$remote_tip"; test -z "$(git -C $C status --porcelain)"; test -d $B; rm -rf $B $T $HOME/agent-workspace/control.compact; echo '=== FINAL STORAGE ==='; du -sh $HOME/local-agent $C $C/.git $C/.agent $HOME/agent-workspace/work $HOME/agent-workspace/checkpoints 2>/dev/null; git -C $C count-objects -vH; echo '=== CONTROL FINAL ==='; git -C $C rev-parse --is-shallow-repository; git -C $C config --get remote.origin.promisor; git -C $C sparse-checkout list; git -C $C status -sb
